jobBuild.text: Build: your goal plus your data, turned into a pipeline you understand and approve.

jobData.text: Data: what you have, recognised and measured. Not what the pipeline needs; no pipeline exists yet. If Build later needs more, it asks, and Data shows it.

jobRun.text: Run: run it, show what happened and what it made.

jobHome.text: Home: one rail on every page. Here: what is running, what needs you, every analysis, and a box to start something new.

jobWelcome.text: Welcome: first launch, or no analyses yet. One question box; no rail.

jobSettings.text: Settings: the same rail, section links in its middle. One scrolling page; a (?) on every option; system facts live in About.

jobForge.text: Forge: find a tool (the registry's gaps are the starters), one Needs you list, your forgings.

jobForging.text: Forging: a tool is a tiny pipeline. Tool: see and shape every part, AI choices in Review. Tests: prove it runs as declared. Publish: pull request → merge → release, every blocker with its fix.

jobRegistry.text: Registry: what exists, in plain words. The format flow, a slim list, a detail panel with takes → makes, how a tool fits, and its rules as decision tables.

jobTokens.text: Every colour on the board is a named token mapped to tokens.css. Each screen has a Dark tweak, and its moon button switches theme.
